answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 54 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 700 fakes must lock 37800 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. What carries the falcon here is verification, the mesa of cost is what stops the farm, and the tundra of the record keeps every claim checkable.
